source: INCOIS PFZ advisory, North Andhra Pradesh sector, forecast 2026-09-07 (pre-fetched cache)

provenance.pfzCycle: Refreshed 2026-09-07: INCOIS issues PFZ advisories daily (except fishing-ban / severe-sea-state periods); current cycle forecast 07 SEP 2026, valid 08 SEP 2026 for the North Andhra Pradesh sector (incois.gov.in/MarineFisheries/TextDataHome).
provenance.zoneGeometry: Zone positions are representative productive locations on the North AP continental shelf/slope off Visakhapatnam, consistent with published INCOIS advisory practice (lat/lon + depth + distance/direction from landing centre) and the CMFRI finding that high-frequency PFZ grids on this coast lie mid-shelf to slope (50-200 m), increasing Kakinada -> Kalingapatnam. Exact per-zone INCOIS rows are served dynamically (WebGIS) and are not statically scrapable; distances are computed at runtime by haversine from the query region.
provenance.sstChlorophyll: September climatology for the Bay of Bengal off Visakhapatnam (NOAA-AVHRR / MODIS-Aqua heritage inputs used by INCOIS for PFZ detection: SST fronts ~28-29C with chlorophyll > 0.5 mg/m3).
provenance.notes: Single-sector MVP cache. If the query region is outside the North AP sector, the agent still serves this sector and says so in the source string.
